deploy-bot: Starting catalog enable for `compass-lite-8b` canary 10% @ us-west-2. rollout_id=cr-68123. Change window 2026-04-10 03:00-05:00 UTC.

nina-rel: Noted. Release note draft updated. Who's setting fallback ordering?

carlos-infra: Suggested ladder: primary=compass-lite-8b -> fallback1=compass-8b-quant -> fallback2=atlas-compat -> fallback3=legacy-16b. Will soft-pin latency-sensitive customers.

lee-sre: Rollback triggers proposed: p50 > 400ms for 10m OR error rate (5xx) > 0.7% sustained 10m. Circuit-breaker if error budget > 40% in 15m. Enabling 150 spans/min trace sampling.

tara-ml: Adding ML guard rails: run SMALL_SMOKE eval every 12m. If semantic-f1 drops > 2% for 2 runs, auto-shift to fallback1 and start regression ticket.

deploy-bot: Canary applied at 10%. Telemetry: /ops/catalog/compass-lite-8b. Check `deploybot status cr-68123`.

nina-rel: Plan: hold 90m at 10%, then 30% for 60m. Manual approvers: @nina-rel, @carlos-infra, @lee-sre.

carlos-infra: EU region capacity limited; adding region cap eu-west=5%. Also enabling route pref to prefer fallback1 for EU if latency risk.

lee-sre: I'll watch the first 60m. Pager thresholds set.

tara-ml: First eval at +12m. Will post summary here.

carlos-infra: Emergency rollback command (staging tested):
```
deploybot rollback cr-68123 --to=compass-8b-quant --force
```
Please confirm dry-run.

deploy-bot: Dry-run success. Alerts will post if thresholds exceeded.

nina-rel: Checkpoints at +30m and +90m. Docs: https://redwood.internal/releases/cr-68123. Good luck. :rocket:
